title: BiasMap: Leveraging Cross-Attentions to Discover and Mitigate Hidden Social Biases in Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on discovering and mitigating social and demographic biases (specifically gender and race) in generative models. While it addresses the ethical implications of fairness and bias, it does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/theological systems.
